# InteractionSwarmAwait

A participant waiting on sub-interactions it started. The run waits (`AwaitingChildren`) until the wait is over; then the participant reads every awaited run's result as the result of its call.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | The wait's id. |
| `processIds` | `uuid[]` | The runs waited on. |
| `all` | `boolean` | True: the wait is over when every one has ended. False: when any one has. |
| `participantName` | `string` | The participant waiting. |
| `threadId` | `string \| null` | The conversation thread the participant's call is on. Null is the main thread. |
| `takenBy` | [`VersionReference`](version-reference.md)`\| null` | The agent that was taking the participant's turn when it waited, when that is not the agent its definition binds (a routed participant's chosen agent): the turn carries on as that agent once the wait is over. Null otherwise. |
| `dateStarted` | `datetime` | When the wait started (UTC). |

## Example

```json
{
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "processIds": [
    "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f"
  ],
  "all": false,
  "participantName": "...",
  "threadId": "...",
  "takenBy": {
    "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
    "version": 0
  },
  "dateStarted": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```
